\/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-\u003Ci\u003EDuring my ICU duties :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003E* I have assisted in the central line procedure, contributing to tasks such as preparing the patient, assisting with sterile draping, and handling necessary equipment under supervision.\"\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* \u003Ci\u003EI have given CPR (CARDIO PULMONARY RESUSCITATION) to revive the patient\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003E- Indications of CPR :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EMain indication is check for pulse and breathing - absence of both - start CPR\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003ECPR includes : 30 compressions , 2 breathes\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EDuring compression Medicine Internship OSCEs Towards Optimizing Clinical Complexity"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This online E-log Entry Blog is an objectively structured clinical examination method to assess the clinical competence during the course of my General Medicine Internship rotation (october'2023-november'2023) by reviewing the case reports shared below and to discuss, understand and review the clinical scenarios and data analysis of patients so as to develop my clinical competency in comprehending clinical cases, and providing evidence-based inputs for questions surrounding the clinical vignettes borrowed from the E Log Book.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENote: The cases have been shared after taking consent from the patient\/guardian. All names and other identifiers have been removed to secure and respect the privacy of the patient and the family\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECASE SCENARIO:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 65 year old female, resident of west bengal and belonging to middle class according to modified kuppuswamy scale presented to the general medicine OPD with chief complaints of:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-continuous dribbling of urine since the past 4 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- constipation since past 3 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- shortness of breath since 3 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 26 years ago , when she developed:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* continuous dull aching pain in both the knee joints, which was exaggerated in the mornings and was bearable throughout the day, it was aggravated on walking and relieved on rest, associated with redness around the knees\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- N\/H\/O trauma\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- N\/H\/O fever with evening rise of temperature, cosmetic deformity(varicosity, skin discoloration)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- later as the disease progressed she underwent bilateral knee replacement surgery in the year 2015.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* continuous dribbling of urine since 4 years, which was insidious in onset with a few drops during the day and gradually progressed to continue throughout the day and wetting of bed during the night, urine is yellow in color with ammonical odour. Aggravated on consumption of coffee \u0026amp; drinking more than 1.5 lit of water.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* patient reports recurrent UTIs where in she complains of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-burning micturition\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-pain before and while micturition\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-no history of hematuria, frothy urine\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* patient also reports constipation since 3 years,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- she passes 1 bowel movement per 2-3 days , associated with pain\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- patient passes flatus\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- not associated with blood, abdominal distention, weight loss\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E* fever since 1 day, sudden onset, high grade, continuous, no aggravating and relieving factors, associated with bodyache, headache.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/pallikhyathi113.blogspot.com\/2023\/10\/a-63yr-old-female-with-rheumatoid.html\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQuestions :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral approach to the patient:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1.List all the complaints of the patient with respect to the history and relevant clinical data and mention the treatment plan for each listed problem and mention treatment plan stating it's efficacy in relevance to patient relief and better outcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnswer:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o continuous dribbling of urine since past 4 yrs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o constipation since 3 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O rheumatoid arthritis since past 26yrs, is on regular medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;H\/O HTN since past 20yrs on regular medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o DM - 2\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETreatment advised :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETab.CLINIDIPINE\/TELMASARTAN\/CHLORTHALIDONE (10\/40\/12.5mg) - This is for her hypertension\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETab.METFORMIN 500mg - This is for her Diabetes\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETab.METHOTREXATE 7.5mg - As she is a known case of RA this is to be continued\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESyp.CREMAFFIN PLUS -This is to treat constipation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor her c\/o continuous urine dribbling we have performed uroflowmetry in our hospital\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg5Dpo44zqxfDOElrAqQtXIX5CTxO2YHsAQ-kMpRG_4PoudsGU-fBvwynEpOjx6IxmQaH7hcsAn687H3hdv8jXk8hawgzS9Ghcq1-fUzH0AqsyaNO_ovs-zHaOO0CYV49X1xH2tFecvA0eEndQiaAeFB7YjH2m_olAxSnjob2Jkyl88gCtYOCiLz3VfOV7s\/s520\/Screenshot_20231126-093556~2.png\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"520\" data-original-width=\"383\" height=\"320\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg5Dpo44zqxfDOElrAqQtXIX5CTxO2YHsAQ-kMpRG_4PoudsGU-fBvwynEpOjx6IxmQaH7hcsAn687H3hdv8jXk8hawgzS9Ghcq1-fUzH0AqsyaNO_ovs-zHaOO0CYV49X1xH2tFecvA0eEndQiaAeFB7YjH2m_olAxSnjob2Jkyl88gCtYOCiLz3VfOV7s\/s320\/Screenshot_20231126-093556~2.png\" width=\"236\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe asked the patient to sit on this chair and ask her to urinate. There is a funnel through which the urine is collected into the jar below and this is connected to the computer monitor through which we can actually get the flow pressure in the form of a graph .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEh5GoSkMtHuoB00K7iEiE3aY69QlQ1-F0h-Qo6O4CV5i8W8Ho-BeYAmc9xzE9DYcbCnvGbS7L3JgN0IsMSXRP937PHuC1vbwSeO6mD3-VaanCEGkhdfm9PakmI09uEX9L8ygQjYBsrPhdYr_e7eHstbM6QhweSauHWhz15fQp3UrcxLx71WOQSd3c4_Sboh\/s1076\/Screenshot_20231126-094031~2.png\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"589\" data-original-width=\"1076\" height=\"175\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEh5GoSkMtHuoB00K7iEiE3aY69QlQ1-F0h-Qo6O4CV5i8W8Ho-BeYAmc9xzE9DYcbCnvGbS7L3JgN0IsMSXRP937PHuC1vbwSeO6mD3-VaanCEGkhdfm9PakmI09uEX9L8ygQjYBsrPhdYr_e7eHstbM6QhweSauHWhz15fQp3UrcxLx71WOQSd3c4_Sboh\/s320\/Screenshot_20231126-094031~2.png\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. What was the rationale behind the initial provisional diagnosis of urosepsis and burning micturition?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnswer- Her blood investigations shows: HAEMOGLOBIN: 10.7 g\/dl\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETOTAL COUNT : 12,100 cells\/comm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENEUTROPHILS: 64%\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELYMPHOCYTES: 11 %\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEOSINOPHILS: 01%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMONOCYTES: 04%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBASOPHILS:00%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPLATELET COUNT2.88\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESMEAR: Normocytic normochromic blood picture with neutrophilic leucocytosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECOMPLETE URINE EXAMINATION (CUE)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;COLOUR: Pale yellow\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAPPEARANCE: Cloudy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREACTION: Acidic\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESP GRAVITY1.010\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EALBUMIN: ++++\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESUGAR: NIL\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBILE SALTS: NIL\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBILE PIGMENTS : NIL\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPUS CELLS: PLENTY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEPITHELIAL CELLS:1-2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. How will you explain the condition to the patient and motivate her to decrease weight as she is a diabetic and couldn't do any physical activity?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnswer:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOur patient she actually wants to decrease her weight but due to the pains she is having she couldn't do it .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFirstly , we have advised her to strictly follow her Diabetic diet and to take them in small intervals and completely avoid maida foods . Gradually her weight would decrease and then the weight pressure on her knees would reduce gradually and\u0026nbsp; there is a chance that she could walk and do some of her physical activities\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComing to her over active bladder , we have advised her some life style changes like avoid the foods \/ drinks that irritate bladder like coffee\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDouble voiding i.e after she goes to bathroom wait for few seconds and try to void again\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlso explained some exercises for relaxing bladder muscles : KEGEL EXERCISE to strengthen the pelvic floor\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlong with the above life style changes and physical exercises advised the patient to continue her medication regularly as prescribed.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr
